description.value:
Poisons your enemies with neurotoxin before they get a chance to blink. One tiny cut is enough to temporarily cut off an enemy's ability to move, allowing you to jump from foe to foe. But be careful - even the smallest cut will make your knees buckle, so if you're gonna cut yourself, make sure it's where your enemies can't see you.

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: Medium Melee • Skill: Melee Weapons • Range: Melee

Damage: 2d6 • Capacity: 4 • ROF: 2 • Hands: 1

Alt. Firing Modes: None

Concealable: Yes

Slots: N/A • Attachments: None • Mods: None

Special Features: Contains a special cartridge that can be loaded with up to 4 doses of Poison, Biotoxin, or Neurotoxin. When this weapon deals damage, the user can immediately inject a dose of the loaded poison without an Action, which applies independently any of the Attack’s regular dealt damage. Loading new cartridges takes a Reload Action.

Range: Melee

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
